claim: sameOriginGuard, the only middleware in front of the new /profile/style, /welcome/bootstrap and /sessions/archive/{name}/delete sinks, has no loopback Host allowlist and trusts Sec-Fetch-Site same-origin, leaving a DNS-rebinding path to state-changing and deleting handlers.
fix: In sameOriginGuard reject with 403 every request whose r.Host is not 127.0.0.1, localhost or [::1] on the served port, before the Sec-Fetch-Site check; add a handler test that a foreign Host is refused on a POST route.

claim: The new default/archived reservation lives in Repo.Validate, which readRegistrySnapshot applies to every stored entry, so an existing repos.json holding a repo named default or archived fails every registry read (Reload, Add, Remove) instead of only refusing new registrations.
fix: Move the reserved-name check out of Repo.Validate into Registry.Add (new registrations only), keeping readRegistrySnapshot tolerant of legacy entries; add a registry test loading a repos.json with a legacy 'archived' entry.

claim: Policy diagnostics deviate from the spec-6 format: the gated verifier message (105) omits the added|modified action, the strict message (93) omits 'outside <detail>', and Why (228) is a constant that never names the resolved base ref.
fix: Render every rule diagnostic as `policy(<mode>): rule <id> <action> outside <detail>` (pass the action into the verifier and strict branches) and build Why from the resolved base ref: `sanction the scope in acdsl/policy.json on <base>, or revert`.

claim: stateNoteFor appends the English 'click to filter this set' / 'click to clear the filter' suffix outside translate(), so German installs render a mixed-language tooltip, breaking spec-4 DR4.
fix: Pass language into stateNoteFor and build the suffix via translate(language, "click to filter this set") / translate(language, "click to clear the filter"), adding both keys to germanCatalog.

claim: germanCatalog has no entry for the new permissions kind heading or its fixed group title 'Allowlist additions', so proposals.html renders both in English on a German profile.
fix: Add germanCatalog entries for the permissions kind heading and its fixed group title, e.g. "permissions": "Berechtigungen", "Allowlist additions": "Freigaben hinzufügen".

claim: routine_worktree_create runs routine_chain_sync_main (unattended /merge-resolve) before smine-nightly/run.sh copies skill-overrides.json into the worktree's .claude/settings.local.json, so a casual profile's 'off' override for merge-resolve does not apply to that run.
fix: Copy ~/.config/claude-routine/skill-overrides.json into $wt/.claude/settings.local.json inside routine_worktree_create right after git worktree add (before routine_chain_sync_main) and drop the per-wrapper copy in smine-nightly/run.sh.

claim: A standalone sync_settings.sh run copies the override-free template over ~/.claude/settings.json, dropping the skillOverrides sync_skills.sh wrote; same cp-over-live root cause as known correctness-BLK-8-r2 (additionalDirectories).
fix: Carry the live file's .skillOverrides (and, with known BLK-8-r2, permissions.additionalDirectories) into the expanded template before sync_file's compare/copy, so one merge step fixes both.

claim: Both orchestrate revert paths mark the proposal entry rejected in <kind>.json, but smine-apply has already moved implemented and auto-applied proposals into archive/done.md, so the rejection has no entry to land on.
fix: In smine-orchestrate L41-42, record the rejection where apply left the proposal: move its archive/done.md entry to archive/rejected.md with status rejected, the reason and the decided date (set status in <kind>.json only when the entry is still there).

claim: The 6h bootstrap deadline kills only the direct bash child (exec.CommandContext, no process group, no cmd.Cancel), so a claude stage child keeps running while the UI reports the bootstrap as no longer running.
fix: Start the bootstrap wrapper in its own process group (Setpgid on unix, a job object or tree kill on Windows) and set cmd.Cancel to kill the whole group, so the 6h deadline stops the stage's claude children before running flips to false.

claim: A remote (non-candidate) FROM that squash-contains the branch is starred IN, but the recount and the status script's squash_in list consult local candidates only, so its commits stay UNPICKED.
fix: When squash_contained holds for a non-candidate FROM, count the FROM-unplaced intersection commits as squashed and include $from in print_agent_worktrees_status.sh's squash_in list.

claim: gate.pass is derived from violations.length alone, so a template row reporting pass:false with an empty violations array passes the gate; nothing pins the aggregation.
fix: Derive gate.pass from the per-template flags (fail when !r.pass, save_button_count !== 1, or unstyled_input_types non-empty) and synthesize a violation string when a failed row carries an empty violations array, instead of gating on violations.length alone.

claim: policyBase passes bare candidate names to git merge-base, which resolves refs/tags/<name> before refs/remotes/<name>; a branch-created tag origin/main makes HEAD the base and CheckPolicy reports nothing.
fix: Resolve policy-base candidates as fully qualified refs (refs/remotes/origin/HEAD, refs/remotes/origin/main, refs/heads/main, refs/heads/master; a set base_ref qualified via git rev-parse --symbolic-full-name and rejected when under refs/tags/) before git merge-base.

claim: docs/workflows.md documents claude/railroad-* lane, refuter and station branch names and cleanup filter, while railroad-review.js builds claude-review/*.
fix: In docs/workflows.md:65 replace the claude/railroad-{direction}-l{i}-r{round}-{hash6}, claude/railroad-refute-…, claude/railroad-station-… names and 'per expected claude/railroad-* branch' with the claude-review/{direction}[-{chunk}]-l{i}-…, claude-review/refute-…, claude-review/station-… and claude-review/* forms the workflow builds.

claim: The peek control port default 42442 is declared twice: DefaultPeekControlPort in installenv.go and the -peek-control-port flag default in cmd/configserver/main.go.
fix: Declare the peek control port default once (int const in internal/config) and use it for the -peek-control-port flag default in cmd/configserver/main.go:52 and in installEnvValues.

claim: writeInstallEnv writes a bare "install.env" literal while the Go reader names the same file separately as installEnvPath.
fix: Export the install.env file name from internal/config (e.g. config.InstallEnvFile) and use it in writeInstallEnv instead of the bare literal.

claim: The listItem-to-Session literal is spelled out in both SessionIndex and SessionsById and has already drifted (GitBranch only in SessionIndex).
fix: Extract sessionFromItem(item listItem) Session (cleaned Cwd, GitBranch, LastActive, Live, Title) and call it from both SessionIndex and SessionsById.

claim: installEnvValues returns map[string]string for install.env although its key set is fixed and its one consumer reads a single key, so a typed model is declarable.
fix: Replace the map[string]string with a typed installEnv struct{ PeekControlPort string } defaulted to DefaultPeekControlPort, and have ExpandInstallMarkers read the field.

claim: Fingerprint hard-codes refs/heads/claude/ and refs/heads/claude-routines/ while WorktreeCounts in the same file takes the prefixes as a parameter; a third copy sits in ops.go.
fix: Declare the agent branch prefixes once in package repos and pass them into Fingerprint (as WorktreeCounts already receives them) and ops.go, instead of hard-coding refs/heads/claude/ and refs/heads/claude-routines/.

claim: The revert-expands-install-markers subtest re-inlines newSectionServer's setup, and the install.env + t.Chdir fixture is duplicated at 121-123 and 142-144.
fix: Use newSectionServer(t, live, fragment) plus server.settingsPath in revert-expands-install-markers, and extract the duplicated install.env + t.Chdir setup (121-123, 142-144) into one t.Helper.

claim: New saveProfileSelection(audience, language, devMode) and writeFileAtomic(path, content) declare parameters out of alphabetical order.
fix: Declare saveProfileSelection(audience string, devMode bool, language string) and writeFileAtomic(content, path string), updating all callers.

claim: styleTestTarget repeats welcome.go checkNightlyRoutine's routines.Scan + IndexFunc(nightlyRoutineName) lookup.
fix: Extract a (s *Server) nightlyRoutine() helper (routines.Scan + IndexFunc on nightlyRoutineName) used by both styleTestTarget and checkNightlyRoutine.

claim: A []repos.WorktreeStatus composite literal is passed inline to statusCache.Store.
fix: Bind statuses := []repos.WorktreeStatus{...} before calling server.statusCache.Store("demo", "", statuses), as the sibling subtest does.

claim: New statusCache.DropBranches(repoName, branches) and Store(repoName, fingerprint, statuses) declare parameters out of alphabetical order.
fix: Declare Store(fingerprint, repoName string, statuses []repos.WorktreeStatus) and DropBranches(branches []string, repoName string), updating callers in repos.go and the tests.

claim: A []repos.WorktreeStatus composite literal is passed inline to cache.Store, unlike the file's other Store calls.
fix: Bind statuses := []repos.WorktreeStatus{{Branch: "claude/alpha"}} and pass it to cache.Store, matching the rest of the file.

claim: The new Archive folder form reuses class reload-form, named for the Reload-from-disk control this diff removed from the page.
fix: Rename the .reload-form spacing class to a neutral name (style.css:354, sessions_index.html:20, _worktree_status.html:27) or give the archive form its own class.

claim: A 5-argument fmt.Sprintf in saveProfileSelection sits on one line.
fix: Split the 5-argument fmt.Sprintf in saveProfileSelection one argument per line with a trailing comma.

claim: The changed timing log.Printf now carries 5 arguments with nested calls on one line.
fix: Split the 5-argument timing log.Printf (with nested formatTimings/len calls) one argument per line with a trailing comma.

claim: routines/README.md still describes smine-nightly as three stages and never names the orchestrate stage, ROUTINE_ORCHESTRATE or SMINE_DEV_MODE.
fix: Name the conditional /smine-orchestrate stage in the smine-nightly row and document ROUTINE_ORCHESTRATE and SMINE_DEV_MODE next to SMINE_AGENTS/SMINE_SUBAGENTS.

claim: The append_result comment lists stages (smine|apply) while callers also pass smine-consolidate and orchestrate.
fix: Change the append_result comment to '$2: stage (smine|smine-consolidate|apply|orchestrate)'.

claim: The t_slash fixture is assigned and never read.
fix: Delete the unused t_slash fixture line, or add a marker-less slash assertion that uses it.

claim: docs/workflows.md documents foreign-toolchain-pretag's return as {gate, builds}; the script returns {tagRef, gate, builds}.
fix: Document the return as `{tagRef, gate, builds}` on docs/workflows.md:106, noting that tagRef echoes the protected tag (empty when none was given).

claim: README.md L224 and L295 still describe dod-report as '4 questions + [DoD] walk' / why-validated-tested after dod-report 1.1 moved to State / Why / Validation & testing / DoD.
fix: Update README.md L224 mermaid label and L295 table row to the v1.1 dod-report shape: State, Why this solution, Validation & testing, DoD summary/walk.

claim: The L74 Rules bullet restates the step-2 Bash(*) and whole-server mcp__server constraints owned by L45-46.
fix: Drop the Bash(*)/mcp__server clauses from the L74 Rules bullet, keeping 'Allow-rules only — never propose a deny or ask rule, never a rule broader than what the evidence granted (step 2)'.

claim: The step-4 permissions branch says 'never touch deny/ask' and again 'allow-rules only, never a deny/ask edit' in one clause.
fix: Delete the trailing '— allow-rules only, never a deny/ask edit' from the step-4 permissions branch; 'never touch deny/ask' already states it.

claim: allowed-tools grants Bash(mv *) although no duty in the body moves a file.
fix: Remove Bash(mv *) from the allowed-tools line; no duty in the body moves a file.

claim: L73 restates the --subagents cost note from the L29 Args bullet as rationale in the skill body.
fix: Delete L73 and the '(current behavior)' tail of L71; keep the cost note only in the L29 --subagents Args bullet.

claim: The bootstrap bullet states seeding-volume leniency twice.
fix: Delete the sentence 'You are the initial setup agent: the machine is being seeded, large output volume is expected and acceptable.'

claim: No test supplies presentation-profile.de.md, so the casual+de template-seeding branch of saveProfileSelection is never exercised.
fix: Add a TestPresentationStore_SaveProfileSelection case that t.Chdir()s into a temp dir holding settings/claude_code/presentation-profile.de.md and asserts the template body (frontmatter stripped) is seeded; add a direct stripFrontMatter table.

claim: Every policy test commit is a main-branch setup commit before checkout -b work, so no CheckPolicy or ruleDelta test covers a change committed on the work branch.
fix: Add a CheckPolicy/ruleDelta case that commits a protected-scope rule addition and a registry.json edit on the work branch before calling CheckPolicy, and assert both diagnostics.

claim: No test calls batchBands with languageGerman or asserts the German Batch / Batch %d-%d strings.
fix: Extend TestBatchBands with a languageGerman case asserting "Auswertung 1–10" and assert the German scope/batch titles in a de-profile sessions page test.

claim: Every status-script stub exits 0, so the err == nil guard on statusCache.Store is never exercised.
fix: Add a worktree-status test whose status stub exits 1: assert StatusErr renders, no cache entry is stored, and the next plain load re-runs the script.

claim: bootstrapEnv rejects a single quote in extra-prompt, but TestBootstrapEnv has no single-quote case.
fix: Add a single-quote extra-prompt fail case ("don't") to TestBootstrapEnv.

claim: The archive tab's rendered delete form is never asserted; the delete route is only POSTed directly.
fix: Assert the archive tab body contains hx-post="/sessions/archive/oldscope/delete".

claim: No test asserts the /profile form binding (dev_mode checked/disabled, language and audience selected) from a stored profile.
fix: Add /profile render cases with a dev-mode profile (checkbox checked) and the casual de profile (casual/de selected, dev_mode disabled).

claim: The bootstrap since/max form defaults computed in welcome.go are never asserted by a test.
fix: Assert the setup tab renders name="since" value=<today-30d> and max=<today>.

claim: No status test pairs a same-subject twin with a squash landing, so the unpicked arm's 'via squash' annotation is never exercised.
fix: Add a status-test case with a same-subject, content-differing commit on main plus a later squash of the branch, asserting the unpicked drill-down prints 'content contained in main via squash'.

claim: run_wrapper inherits ambient SMINE_DEV_MODE, BOOTSTRAP_SINCE and BOOTSTRAP_N, so an exported value flips the defaults-case assertions.
fix: Have run_wrapper unset SMINE_DEV_MODE, BOOTSTRAP_SINCE, BOOTSTRAP_N, BOOTSTRAP_EXTRA_PROMPT and SMINE_AGENTS (env -u ...) and pass per-case overrides explicitly.

claim: The only truncated-cache fixture writes 'garbage', which fails the key clause first, so the 5-line completeness clause never decides a test outcome.
fix: Make the truncation case keep the valid key line and drop the rest (head -2 of the row file), so only the 5-line completeness check can force the miss.

claim: No cache test moves origin/main after warming the cache, so the $from_tip key part (the only one that sees a remote FROM move) is untested.
fix: Add a cache case that warms the cache on an origin/main-FROM branch, moves refs/remotes/origin/main with update-ref, and asserts the next traced run probes again.

claim: policyBase decides isBoundary by branch name (branch != baseName) instead of spec-6's HEAD == base tip comparison; the L189-192 comment records this as deliberate.
fix: none

claim: session-mine.js adds a Drift stage, a model/effort tier override and --subagents forwarding that none of the 14 specs names.
fix: none
